projects.title: Copilot governance lab
projects.problem: Identify broadly accessible sensitive information before discussing wider AI access.
projects.cap: Explicit metadata rules, synthetic tenant fixture and matplotlib report
projects.limit: No live Microsoft tenant, semantic query evaluation, permission changes or Power BI integration.
projects.run:
python main.py
python evaluate.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
projects.note: Ten labelled policy cases; uncertainty is a review state. Compare with explicit rules before adding an AI model.

projects.title: Operations telemetry lab
projects.problem: Help an operator judge whether unusual telemetry deserves investigation.
projects.cap: Deterministic synthetic telemetry, held-out Isolation Forest and threshold comparison
projects.limit: PowerShell runbooks produce plans only. Power BI is a manual CSV-import blueprint. No measured setup-time reduction, self-healing or cost saving.
projects.run:
python main.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
projects.note: 1,000 synthetic records; 600 training and 400 held-out rows. The simple threshold is a required baseline, not an inferior alternative by assumption.

projects.title: Workspace governance plans and runbooks
projects.problem: Review inactivity candidates and plan sensitivity labels without overwriting unrelated settings.
projects.cap: Offline fixtures, explicit live scope, delegated label-change guard, backups and verified rollback path
projects.limit: Live Graph operations are implemented but have not been tenant-tested. Fixtures do not establish tenant security or regulatory compliance.
projects.run:
pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/Test-Fixtures.ps1
pwsh -NoProfile -File Scripts/Enforce-PurviewLabels.ps1
pwsh -NoProfile -File Scripts/Audit-UnusedSharePointSites.ps1
projects.note: Default mode uses fixtures. Existing labels require review; replacement is a separate explicit option. Live writes require delegated access, selected group IDs and -Apply.

projects.title: Tenant Guard — drift fixtures
projects.problem: Show how identity, endpoint and sharing checks report configuration drift.
projects.cap: Three deterministic PowerShell demonstrations and expected-exit verification
projects.limit: No Microsoft Graph connection or automated remediation. Exit 1 is expected for the supplied non-compliant fixtures.
projects.note: The harness succeeds only when all three intentionally bad fixtures report drift. A clean script exit is not a live tenant assessment.

projects.title: SmartLifeCycle Ops — endpoint and ML lab
projects.problem: Explore device onboarding plans and compare a classifier with a simple refresh rule.
projects.cap: FastAPI simulation and deterministic synthetic Random Forest training
projects.limit: No Intune, JAMF or directory changes. The class probability describes synthetic labels; it is not real device-failure risk.
projects.deps:
fastapi==0.141.1
uvicorn==0.52.4
pydantic==2.13.5
httpx==0.28.1
email-validator==2.3.0
pandas==2.3.3
numpy==2.2.6
scikit-learn==1.8.0
projects.note: 2,500 synthetic records; 2,000 training and 500 test rows. The generating rule is the baseline. A fresh small model is built in memory; no committed pickle is loaded.

projects.title: AI prioritisation and scenario explorer
projects.problem: Make subjective impact, feasibility and resource assumptions visible before deciding what to build.
projects.cap: Validated 60/40 scoring, quadrant logic and illustrative resource arithmetic
projects.limit: No achieved ROI, vendor quotation, measured carbon footprint or net-zero assessment. Coefficients are hypothetical teaching inputs.
projects.run:
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
streamlit run app.py
projects.note: Core tests cover bounds, non-finite values, booleans and negative usage. Read docs/assumptions.md before interpreting the scenarios.

projects.title: Draft policy-assessment lab
projects.problem: Explore a structured model suggestion against a small set of sample communication policies.
projects.cap: FastAPI contract, static policy context, strict output validation and mandatory human-review state
projects.limit: No legal/regulatory certification or automatic approval. Local tests mock the provider; live model false-approval and false-rejection rates remain unmeasured.
projects.run:
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
projects.deps:
fastapi==0.141.1
uvicorn==0.52.4
pydantic==2.13.5
httpx==0.28.1
openai==2.54.0
python-dotenv==1.2.3
projects.note: Health and mocked contract tests need no key. A real audit request needs configured OpenAI/Azure access and may incur costs; it is outside the offline lab. Evaluation cases live in docs/evaluation-cases.json.

projects.title: Document-to-initiative analysis demo
projects.problem: Turn a permitted source page into a reviewable draft initiative assessment.
projects.cap: Bounded page extraction, LLM prompt and validated JSON-to-workbook fields
projects.limit: Fetch-and-prompt workflow, not indexed RAG or an autonomous strategy engine. Proposed objectives and targets are drafts, not achieved business results.
projects.deps:
pandas==2.3.3
openpyxl==3.1.5
requests==2.32.5
beautifulsoup4==4.15.0
python-dotenv==1.2.3
openai==2.54.0
projects.note: Tests cover malformed results, missing pages and separation of hostile page text from trusted instructions. They do not establish immunity to prompt injection. Live workbook processing requires permitted URLs and a model key.

projects.title: Thinkbox portfolio assistant
projects.problem: Let a visitor find real project evidence without depending on an LLM conversation.
projects.cap: React project/career pages and Flask catalogue backed by the same portfolio.json
projects.limit: Optional chat needs provider access. The previous fictional employment/project examples have been removed from the portfolio routes; no template proficiency ratings are treated as facts.
projects.note: Adapted from Andrew Baisden’s ai-agent-app. Original attribution is retained in CONTRIBUTIONS.md. Static project evidence is the default route.

projects.title: Customer-satisfaction pipeline learning
projects.problem: Compare a review-score predictor with a simple baseline while separating preprocessing and evaluation.
projects.cap: Local group-split benchmark with training-only imputation, mean baseline and Ridge model
projects.limit: One local holdout does not validate production serving, temporal performance, drift monitoring or causal business effects. Earlier ZenML code is retained as legacy study material.
projects.note: Starting point credits Ayush Singh. The duplicated inner directory was flattened; see mlops-project/MIGRATION.md and data provenance. Historical dependency pins are in requirements-legacy.txt.

projects.title: Learning notes and small experiments
projects.problem: Record learning and show a small, inspectable feed-parsing experiment.
projects.cap: A local Atom-feed fixture and the existing Flask release-notes viewer
projects.limit: This is a learning area. Reference PDFs are third-party material, not authored portfolio applications. Google Drive/AGY automation is separate and unvalidated here.
projects.note: The supported demo parses a synthetic Atom document without network access. The optional /api/releases endpoint fetches the official BigQuery feed; it is not run by the offline test.

projects.title: Content Flow — writing workflow application
projects.problem: Organise drafts, adaptations and review steps while preserving publication truth.
projects.cap: Node application, SQLite storage, provider adapters and a queue that stops at manual review
projects.limit: No social-platform publishing adapter is implemented. Mock provider outputs are demonstrations. A queue state or simulated engagement score does not prove a published post or audience result.
projects.run:
npm ci
npm test
npm run build
projects.note: A due item becomes ready_for_review. A published state requires a verified receipt with URL and time; no live post is created by the demo.

projects.title: Grid Manager — Java design and scenario reporting
projects.problem: Explain source-selection decisions through modular software and a repeatable scenario.
projects.cap: Builder/Factory/Strategy design, SQLite history, cost-calculation service and JUnit tests
projects.limit: Inputs and source switching are software scenarios. No physical grid or live sensor integration. Cost/carbon coefficients and demand-to-energy conversion are assumptions, not validated savings.
projects.note: Java 24+ and Maven 3.9+ required. run.sh uses Maven from the project directory; ./run.sh gui is optional. Tests target the current CostCalculationService, not removed SwitchReport methods.

projects.title: Smart Home energy and solar scenarios
projects.problem: Explain appliance cost calculations and test a simple solar attenuation scenario against persistence.
projects.cap: Local Python calculations, solar scenario classes, optional AI explanation and a small evaluation
projects.limit: Fixed attenuation factors are not a validated weather forecast. Evaluation uses hand-authored synthetic cases; no physical device actions or realised savings.
projects.run:
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python demo_solar_prediction.py
python evaluate_solar.py
projects.note: Local calculations, menu and solar demo work without an API key. python src/main.py opens the menu; optional AI explanation requires a configured key.
